notes.title: New UI update for the Demo
notes.content:
[h2][b]✨ What’s New in This Update?[/b][/h2]

🎨 Fresh New Style – Menus & In-Game Visuals

We gave Chessfinity a full aesthetic upgrade. Expect cleaner, sharper, and more vibrant visuals across the board:
	•	Revamped main menus with improved navigation
	•	Smoother UI transitions and animations
	•	A new in-game HUD that gives all the information a player needs 

🔍 Detailed Move Patterns for Mana Chess

	•	Easier to plan your strategy
	•	More intuitive gameplay, especially for new players

🧩 Improved Deck Page & Deck Building

	•	New deck view makes it easier to understand your build at a glance
	•	Better sorting and selection tools to help you craft the perfect loadout

notes.title: Chessfinity Update Announcement – New Features Unlocked!
notes.content:
📢 Chessfinity Update Announcement – New Features Unlocked! 🚀♟️
🔥 BIG UPDATE ALERT! We’ve just added some new features to Chessfinity!

🔄 Switch Between Views!
👀 New Top-Down (Orthographic) Mode → Play in a classic 2D-style overhead view OR keep the dynamic 3D perspective.

♟️ 4-Player Online Mode is Live!
🎮 Jump into online matches and experience the full chaos of multiplayer chess! This is an early test, so we’d love your feedback on balancing & mechanics.

notes.title: Demo updated
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299237/c9025962a0d3ab93165b092a5fbfade5f03769ad.jpg[/img]Navigating a multi-layered chess battlefield can be overwhelming, that's why our UI team focuses on legibility and visibility in the game. We have recently added features such as a movement log, dynamic piece tracking, toggleable 3D coordinates, and colour-coded move indicators—ensuring players always have a clear tactical view across all levels.

As always - we welcome your feedbacks if there is any visibility issues within the game! 

[list]
[*]
[/list][b]Notation[/b] has been fixed to account for skipped moves whilst keeping the order number legible. 
[list]
[*]
[/list][b]Logs[/b] now show active pieces and their move patterns in their position.
[list]
[*]
[/list][b]Board coordinates[/b] toggle-able ON/OFF and Auto
